siteUrl.description: Site URL for the tracking code.

personId.description: Unique identifier for the user. At least one parameter of `personId` or `email` is required. `personId` must precede `email` if both are specified.

email.description: Email address for the user. At least one parameter of `personId` or `email` is required. `personId` must precede `email` if both are specified.
